verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents user data export/import via bulk export and gradual migration, plus log streaming export of tenant logs, giving some data-portability capability. However, docs don't specify the export format as an open standard (e.g., JSON/CSV schema) for full account data, and community commentary explicitly flags 'strong vendor lock-in' as a known limitation, undercutting a clean 'leave freely' narrative. Missing for 10: explicit open-format specification for exported data, full GDPR-style data portability documentation, and independent evidence users can fully migrate away without lock-in friction.
